marta: Heads-up — I want to run an automated cleanup that adds 'needs_enablement' tag for accounts with no enablement_events and health_score < 0.3, created >7d. Sharing filter + safety checks. @sunil @jamie

sunil: Paste the exact filter and what metadata gets written. We must not touch accounts with 'pilot' or 'enterprise' flags, and exclude 'no-contact'.

jamie: Also snapshot health_score and write a trace_id so we can revert by trace. If >0.5% of pilot rows change owner_claimed or health_score jumps >0.45, abort.

marta: Dry-run SQL below, will write snapshot cs_health_snapshot_20260324 and tag via job service.
```sql
SELECT a.account_id, a.created_at, coalesce(ev.cnt,0) AS enablement_events, h.health_score, a.metadata->>'pilot' AS pilot_flag
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM enablement_events WHERE created_at > now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY account_id) ev USING (account_id)
LEFT JOIN cs_health h USING (account_id)
WHERE a.created_at <= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND coalesce(ev.cnt,0) = 0
  AND h.health_score < 0.3
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM account_flags WHERE flag IN ('no-contact','enterprise'))
LIMIT 250;
```

rachel: Add owner_webhook for any tagged accounts and a 'silent' pilot of 250 first. ops-bot: schedule dry_run.
